apiMessages.content: Add overhead press to Wednesday's upper body workout, 5 sets of 5.

Can't do that — overhead press is banned per your PT for 8 more weeks (rotator cuff tendinopathy), and I don't override that restriction.

Alternative for shoulder strength that stays overhead-press-free: Landmine Press + Reach (low-angle, shoulder-friendly) or more rows/face-pulls for rear delt/cuff work. Want me to add one of those instead?
